PerkDescription.zh: 提高雌激素水平并获得怀孕和生育孩子的能力。
PerkDescription.en: Boosts estrogen levels and confers the capacity to conceive and bear children.
PerkDescription.ja: 女性ホルモンを増やし、妊娠できるようになる。

PerkDescription.zh: 提高雄激素水平并获得使别人怀孕的能力。
PerkDescription.en: Boosts testosterone levels and confers the ability to impregnate.
PerkDescription.ja: 男性ホルモンを増やし、妊娠させられるようになる。

PerkDescription.zh: 强化同理心和女性身体特征，例如更宽的臀部和更丰满的乳房，增加整体女性气质。
PerkDescription.en: Increases empathy and female physical traits such as breast size and hip width, increasing overall femininity.
PerkDescription.ja: 共感性を高め、胸の大きさや腰幅といった女性的な身体的特徴を強め、全体的な女性らしさを増す。

PerkDescription.zh: 弱化女性身体特征，如乳房大小和臀部宽度，并削弱整体女性气质。
PerkDescription.en: Reduces female physical traits such as breast size and hip width, decreasing overall femininity.
PerkDescription.ja: 女性ホルモンが少ない。積極性が増す。ヒップや胸のサイズが小さくなり女性らしさが減る。

PerkDescription.zh: 强化自信和男性身体特征，例如体毛增加、身材更高以及肌肉密度更大。
PerkDescription.en: Increases assertiveness and male physical traits such as body hair, larger stature and greater muscle mass.
PerkDescription.ja: 男性ホルモンが多い。積極性が増す。体毛が多く、身長が高く、筋肉量が多い。

PerkDescription.zh: 弱化男性身体特征，导致外观更年轻、身材更小以及肌肉密度更低。
PerkDescription.en: Reduces male physical traits, leading to a more youthful appearance, smaller stature, and less muscle mass.
PerkDescription.ja: 男性ホルモンが少ない。見た目が若々しく、身長が小さく、筋肉量が少ない。

PerkDescription.zh: 会导致体温流失更快。
PerkDescription.en: Makes you lose temperature faster.
PerkDescription.ja: 体温が下がりやすくなる

PerkDescription.zh: 为您提供永久的蚊虫防护。
PerkDescription.en: Gives you  permanent mosquito/bug protection.
PerkDescription.ja: 恒久的な蚊・虫除け効果を得る

PerkDescription.zh: 让你更能抵抗疾病。
PerkDescription.en: Makes you more resistant to disease.
PerkDescription.ja: 病気にかかりにくい。

PerkDescription.zh: 让你更容易生病。
PerkDescription.en: Makes you more susceptible to disease.
PerkDescription.ja: 病気にかかりやすい。

PerkDescription.zh: 让你更难抵抗疼痛。
PerkDescription.en: Makes you more sensitive to pain.
PerkDescription.ja: 痛みの感じやすさ

PerkDescription.zh: 让你更能抵抗疼痛。
PerkDescription.en: Makes you more resistant to pain.
PerkDescription.ja: 痛みに強くなる。

PerkDescription.zh: 让你更快地消耗脂肪储备，体温更高。
PerkDescription.en: Makes you burn through your fat reserves faster and have a higher body temperature.
PerkDescription.ja: 脂肪が燃えるのがはやく、体温が高い。

PerkDescription.zh: 让你更慢地消耗脂肪储备，体温更低。
PerkDescription.en: Makes you burn through your fat reserves slower and have a lower body temperature.
PerkDescription.ja: 脂肪が燃えるのがおそく、体温が低い。

PerkDescription.zh: 让你更快地感到饥饿，更容易进食，因此更难营养不良。
PerkDescription.en: Makes you hungry faster, making eating easier so it's harder to become malnourished.
PerkDescription.ja: 腹の減りが早く、栄養失調になりにくい。

PerkDescription.zh: 延缓你的饥饿感，使你更难进食，更容易营养不良。
PerkDescription.en: Delays your hunger, making it harder to eat and easier to get malnourished.
PerkDescription.ja: Delays your hunger, making it harder to eat and easier to get malnourished.

PerkDescription.zh: 你的肠道产生废物的速度更快，你需要更频繁地大便。
PerkDescription.en: Your bowels produce waste faster, requiring you to pass stools more often.
PerkDescription.ja: 消化が早くなり、トイレに行く頻度が上がる。

PerkDescription.zh: 你的肠道直通虚空，让你摆脱大便的俗务缠身。
PerkDescription.en: Your bowels lead straight into the void, relieving you from the mundane vulgarities of passing stools.
PerkDescription.ja: 腸が虚無と繋がり、排便から解放される。

PerkDescription.zh: 你的肠道产生废物的速度更慢，你不需要太频繁地大便。
PerkDescription.en: Your bowels take longer to produce waste, requiring you to pass stools less often.
PerkDescription.ja: 消化が遅くなり、トイレに行く頻度が下がる。

PerkDescription.zh: 让你更快地口渴和脱水，你需要更频繁地喝水。
PerkDescription.en: Makes you thirsty faster and dehydrated faster, requiring you to drink more often.
PerkDescription.ja: 喉が渇くのが早くなり、脱水になりやすい。

PerkDescription.zh: 你很少口渴和脱水，不需要频繁地喝水。
PerkDescription.en: You are slower to get thirsty and dehydrated, requiring you to drink less often.
PerkDescription.ja: 喉が渇くのが遅くなり、脱水になりにくい。

PerkDescription.zh: 你的膀胱直通虚空，让你摆脱撒尿的俗务缠身。
PerkDescription.en: Your bladder leads straight into the void, relieving you from the mundane vulgarities of passing urine.
PerkDescription.ja: 膀胱が虚無と繋がり、排尿から解放される。

PerkDescription.zh: 你的膀胱容量超大，你不需要太频繁地撒尿。
PerkDescription.en: Your bladder has increased urine capacity, requiring you to urinate less often.
PerkDescription.ja: 膀胱が大きくなり、トイレに行く頻度が下がる。

PerkDescription.zh: 你的膀胱太小了，你总得撒尿。
PerkDescription.en: Your bladder has decreased urine capacity, requiring you to urinate more often.
PerkDescription.ja: 膀胱が小さくなり、トイレに行く頻度が下がる。

PerkDescription.zh: 吃蔬菜会让你恶心和抑郁。
PerkDescription.en: Eating vegetables makes you sick and depressed.
PerkDescription.ja: 野菜を食べると体調を崩して気分が落ちる。

PerkDescription.zh: 吃肉会让你恶心和抑郁。
PerkDescription.en: Eating meat makes you sick and depressed.
PerkDescription.ja: 肉を食べると体調を崩して気分が落ちる。

PerkDescription.zh: 增强对冻伤/冻疮的抵抗力，并减缓体温下降速度。
PerkDescription.en: Makes you more resistant to frostnip/frostbite and makes you lose temperature slower.
PerkDescription.ja: 凍傷や霜焼けに強くなり、体温が下がりにくくなる

PerkDescription.zh: 增强面部和谐感，提升整体吸引力。
PerkDescription.en: Increases facial harmony, improving general attractiveness.
PerkDescription.ja: Increases facial harmony, improving general attractiveness.

PerkDescription.zh: 削弱面部和谐感，降低整体吸引力。
PerkDescription.en: Decreases facial harmony, worsening general attractiveness.
PerkDescription.ja: Decreases facial harmony, worsening general attractiveness.

PerkDescription.zh: 减小你的体型和攻击距离，降低能量消耗并提高潜行能力。
PerkDescription.en: Decreases your size and combat reach, decreases caloric needs and enhances stealth capabilities.
PerkDescription.ja: リーチが短くなる。だがステルス能力が上がり、必要なカロリーが少なくなる。

PerkDescription.zh: 增大你的体型和攻击距离、提高能量消耗并降低潜行能力。
PerkDescription.en: Increases your size and combat reach, reduces stealth, and raises your caloric needs.
PerkDescription.ja: リーチが長くなる。だがステルス能力が落ち、必要なカロリーが多くなる。

PerkDescription.zh: 大幅减小你的体型和攻击距离，降低能量消耗并提高潜行能力。
PerkDescription.en: Dramatically decreases your size and combat reach, decreases caloric needs and enhances stealth capabilities.
PerkDescription.ja: リーチがかなり短くなる。だがステルス能力が上がり、必要なカロリーが少なくなる。

PerkDescription.zh: 大幅增大你的体型和攻击距离、提高能量消耗并降低潜行能力。
PerkDescription.en: Dramatically increases your size and combat reach, reduces stealth, and raises your caloric needs.
PerkDescription.ja: リーチがかなり長くなる。だがステルス能力が落ち、必要なカロリーが多くなる。

PerkDescription.zh: 大大减轻你的体重，削弱你的免疫系统、能量水平和保温。如果没有足够的营养，你离死亡还有几周的时间。
PerkDescription.en: Drastically reduces your body weight, compromising your immune system, energy levels and insulation. Leaves you a few weeks away from death without adequate nutrition.
PerkDescription.ja: 体重が大幅に落ち、免疫力とエネルギーが損なわれ、体が温まりにくくなる。栄養が足りないと数週間で死ぬ。

PerkDescription.zh: 显著增加你的体重，增加脂肪储备和保温，但会降低耐力和灵活性。
PerkDescription.en: Significantly increases your body weight, boosting fat reserves and insulation but reducing stamina and mobility.
PerkDescription.ja: 体重がかなり増える。体脂肪が増え、体が温まりやすくなる。その代わり、スタミナと素早さが落ちる。

PerkDescription.zh: 增加你的体重，略微增加脂肪储备和保温，同时少量降低你的耐力。
PerkDescription.en: Increases your body weight, slightly boosting fat reserves and insulation while reducing your stamina by a small amount.
PerkDescription.ja: 体重が増える。体脂肪が増え、体が温まりやすくなる。その代わりスタミナと素早さが少し落ちる。

PerkDescription.zh: 减轻体重，减少脂肪储备，略微削弱免疫系统和保温。
PerkDescription.en: Reduces your body weight, lowering fat reserves and slightly impairing your immune system and thermal insulation.
PerkDescription.ja: 体重が落ち、体脂肪が減る。免疫力と温度が落ちる。

PerkDescription.zh: 你初始就有很高的体魄水平，显著提升你的耐力和能量。
PerkDescription.en: You start with very high fitness levels, dramatically increasing your stamina and energy levels.
PerkDescription.ja: フィットネスのレベルがかなり高く、スタミナとエネルギーがすごい。

PerkDescription.zh: 你初始就有不错的体魄水平，提升你的耐力和能量。
PerkDescription.en: You start with high fitness levels, increasing your stamina and energy levels.
PerkDescription.ja: フィットネスのレベルが高く、スタミナとエネルギーが多い。

PerkDescription.zh: 你初始的体魄水平较低，降低了你的耐力和能量。
PerkDescription.en: You start with low fitness levels, decreasing your stamina and energy levels.
PerkDescription.ja: フィットネスのレベルが低く、スタミナとエネルギーが少ない。

PerkDescription.zh: 在多云等天气下更难获得阳光，但会让你更不容易晒伤。
PerkDescription.en: Makes it harder to get sunlight in conditions like cloudy weather, but makes you less susceptible to sun damage.
PerkDescription.ja: 曇りだと日光の影響を受けにくくなる。日光ダメージに強い。

PerkDescription.zh: 在多云等天气下更能获得阳光，但会让你更容易晒伤。
PerkDescription.en: Makes it easier to get sunlight in cloudy weather, but makes you more susceptible to sun damage.
PerkDescription.ja: 曇りでも日光の影響を受けやすくなる。日光ダメージに弱い。

PerkDescription.zh: 在多云等天气下极其难获得阳光，但会让你几乎不会晒伤。
PerkDescription.en: Makes it significantly harder to get sunlight in cloudy weather, but makes you considerably less susceptible to sun damage.
PerkDescription.ja: 曇りだと日光の影響をかなり受けにくくなる。日光ダメージに相当強くなる。

PerkDescription.zh: 在多云等天气下极易获得阳光，但会让你非常容易晒伤。
PerkDescription.en: Makes it significantly easier to get sunlight in cloudy weather, but makes you considerably more susceptible to sun damage.
PerkDescription.ja: 曇りでも日光の影響をかなり受けやすくなる。日光ダメージにかなり弱い。

PerkDescription.zh: 在多云等天气下稍难获得阳光，但会让你更不容易晒伤。
PerkDescription.en: Makes it slightly harder to get sunlight in cloudy weather, but makes you less susceptible to sun damage.
PerkDescription.ja: 曇りだと少し日光の影響を受けにくくなる。日光ダメージに強い。

PerkDescription.zh: 在多云等天气下稍易获得阳光，但会让你更容易晒伤。
PerkDescription.en: Makes it slightly easier to get sunlight in cloudy weather, but makes you more susceptible to sun damage.
PerkDescription.ja: 曇りでも少し日光の影響を受けやすくなる。日光ダメージに弱い。

PerkDescription.zh: 在明亮的光线环境中提高你的视力。
PerkDescription.en: Improves your sight in bright light environments.
PerkDescription.ja: 明るい環境だと視力が良くなる。

PerkDescription.zh: 在昏暗的光线环境中提高你的视力。
PerkDescription.en: Improves your sight in low light conditions.
PerkDescription.ja: 暗い環境だと視力が良くなる。。

PerkDescription.zh: 你能在黑暗中看清。
PerkDescription.en: You can see in the Dark.
PerkDescription.ja: 暗闇でも見通せる。

PerkDescription.zh: 你的身体上覆盖着毛皮，保护你免受寒冷，并赋予你独特的外观。
PerkDescription.en: Your body is covered in fur, protecting you from the cold and giving you a unique look.
PerkDescription.ja: 体が毛皮に覆われ、寒さから身を守り、異様な姿を与える。

PerkDescription.zh: 开局拥有手茧和足茧。
PerkDescription.en: Makes you start with some hand and foot callouses.
PerkDescription.ja: 手足に多少のたこがある状態で開始する

PerkDescription.zh: 幽闭恐惧症增长更快速。
PerkDescription.en: Gain cabin fever faster.
PerkDescription.ja: キャビンフィーバーが早く蓄積する

PerkDescription.zh: 幽闭恐惧症增长更缓慢。
PerkDescription.en: Gain cabin fever slower.
PerkDescription.ja: キャビンフィーバーの蓄積が遅くなる

PerkDescription.zh: 让你更容易保持情绪高昂。
PerkDescription.en: Makes it easier to keep your morale high.
PerkDescription.ja: 基本的に気分はいい。

PerkDescription.zh: 让你更难保持情绪高昂。
PerkDescription.en: Makes it harder to keep your morale high.
PerkDescription.ja: 基本的に気分は落ちてる。

PerkDescription.zh: 你强健、坚定的世界观让你能抵抗精神状态的改变。 警告：这将使魔法变得不可能完成。
PerkDescription.en: Your robust, firm worldview makes you resistant to altered mind states. Warning: Will make magic impossible.
PerkDescription.ja: かなり頑固。精神状態が全く変化しない。 注意：魔法が使えない。

PerkDescription.zh: 你开放的心态和敏感的天性让你更容易改变精神状态。
PerkDescription.en: Your open minded and sensitive nature makes it easier for you to reach altered mind states.
PerkDescription.ja: 優しくて繊細な性格。精神状態が変化しやすい。

PerkDescription.zh: 你更容易感到压力，但也更加警觉、不易受惊。
PerkDescription.en: You tend to get stressed more easily, but are also more alert, making you harder to surprise.
PerkDescription.ja: ストレスは溜まりやすいが、周囲力が高い。

PerkDescription.zh: 你很难感到压力，但也更缺乏警觉，容易受惊。
PerkDescription.en: You find it harder to get stressed, but are also less alert, making you easier to surprise.
PerkDescription.ja: ストレスは溜まりにくいが注意力が低い。

PerkDescription.zh: 你更容易保持专注，哪怕是重复性的工作，但你社交能力较差。
PerkDescription.en: You are more likely to stay focused, even on repetitive tasks, but are less socially adept.
PerkDescription.ja: 集中力は高いが社交的ではない。

PerkDescription.zh: 你很难对重复性的工作保持专注，但在做有趣的事时会格外专注而有创造力。
PerkDescription.en: You have trouble staying focused if you're not engaged but are more creative and get extra focus when working on interesting things.
PerkDescription.ja: 集中力は基本的に低いが、クリエイティブで興味ある物に対する集中力は全く切れない。

PerkDescription.zh: 给予你勇气，允许你执行可怕的动作，并在战斗中坚持更长时间，但也使你更容易受惊。
PerkDescription.en: Gives you courage, allowing you to perform scary actions and remain in combat for longer, but making you easier to surprise.
PerkDescription.ja: 勇気が必要なアクションと長い戦闘が得意だが、サプライズが苦手。

PerkDescription.zh: 你很难执行可怕的动作或坚持长时间战斗，但也更不易受惊。
PerkDescription.en: You are less able to perform scary actions and have trouble remaining in combat, but are harder to surprise.
PerkDescription.ja: 怖いアクションと長い戦闘が苦手だが、サプライズには強い。

PerkDescription.zh: 你受孤独感的困扰更小，但更难从与人互动中获得情绪价值。
PerkDescription.en: You suffer less from the effects of loneliness, but get less value from interacting with others.
PerkDescription.ja: 独りでいることを辛いと感じないが、他人と関わってもあまりいいことがない。

PerkDescription.zh: 你难以忍受孤独，但能从与人互动中获得额外的情绪价值。
PerkDescription.en: You suffer more from the effects of loneliness, but get additional value from interacting with others.
PerkDescription.ja: 孤独に弱いが、他人と関わることによって得るものが増える。

PerkDescription.zh: 在进行创造性活动时获得额外的幸福感。
PerkDescription.en: Gain additional wellbeing when performing creative actions.
PerkDescription.ja: クリエイティブなアクションをするとき、幸福度がさらに上がる。

PerkDescription.zh: 在进行高难体能活动时获得额外的幸福感。
PerkDescription.en: Gain additional wellbeing when performing physically demanding actions.
PerkDescription.ja: 体を使うアクションをするとき、幸福度がさらに上がる。

PerkDescription.zh: 你意志坚定，但因此很难信任别人、不易与他人相处。
PerkDescription.en: You have a strong will, but are less trusting as a result and have more trouble getting along with others.
PerkDescription.ja: 意志は強いが、なかなか人を信じることができず、打ち解けるのが苦手。

PerkDescription.zh: 你更信任别人，更容易与他人相处，代价是比较缺乏自主性。
PerkDescription.en: You are more trusting of others, making it easier to get along with them, at the cost of some autonomy.
PerkDescription.ja: すぐに人のことを信じ、打ち解けやすいが、自立が苦手。

PerkDescription.zh: 让你对难闻的气味、污垢和丑陋的环境免疫。
PerkDescription.en: Makes you immune to bad smells, filth and general unsightliness.
PerkDescription.ja: 悪臭、汚れや不快なものに耐性ができる。

PerkDescription.zh: 让你难以忍受难闻的气味、污垢和丑陋的环境。
PerkDescription.en: Makes you especially susceptible to bad smells, filth and general unsightliness.
PerkDescription.ja: 嫌な臭いと汚いものが苦手。

PerkDescription.zh: 在吃肉时获得额外的幸福感。
PerkDescription.en: You gain additional wellbeing from eating meat.
PerkDescription.ja: 肉を食べると幸福度がさらに上がる。

PerkDescription.zh: 在吃蔬菜时获得额外的幸福感。
PerkDescription.en: You gain additional wellbeing from eating vegetables.
PerkDescription.ja: 野菜を食べると幸福度がさらに上がる。

PerkDescription.zh: 在吃甜食时获得额外的幸福感。
PerkDescription.en: You gain additional wellbeing from eating sweet food.
PerkDescription.ja: 甘いものを食べると幸福度がさらに上がる。

PerkDescription.zh: 从春季开始。
PerkDescription.en: Start in spring.
PerkDescription.ja: 春から開始する。

PerkDescription.zh: 开局自带一个泥屋。
PerkDescription.en: Start with a mudhut.
PerkDescription.ja: 泥小屋を持った状態で開始する。

PerkDescription.zh: 开局自带一个木屋。
PerkDescription.en: Start with a cabin
PerkDescription.ja: 小屋を持った状態で開始する。

PerkDescription.zh: 在南部湖岸开始游戏
PerkDescription.en: Start at the Southern Lake Bank
PerkDescription.ja: 南の湖岸から開始する

PerkDescription.zh: 在古旧寂谷开始游戏
PerkDescription.en: Start at the Old Hollow
PerkDescription.ja: 古き窪地から開始する

PerkDescription.zh: 在鹿鸣松林开始游戏
PerkDescription.en: Start at the Deer Grove
PerkDescription.ja: 鹿の林から開始する

PerkDescription.zh: 世界温度永久-20度。
PerkDescription.en: Permanent -20 degrees modifier.
PerkDescription.ja: 常時ー２０度の補正。

PerkDescription.zh: 世界温度永久+20度。
PerkDescription.en: Permanent +20 degrees modifier.
PerkDescription.ja: 常時＋２０度の補正

PerkDescription.zh: 一直下雨。
PerkDescription.en: It rains all the time.
PerkDescription.ja: 常に雨が降る

PerkDescription.zh: 从不下雨。
PerkDescription.en: It never rains.
PerkDescription.ja: 雨が降らない

PerkDescription.zh: 游戏开局自带皮革裤、皮革长袍、皮革鞋和一件芦苇大衣。
PerkDescription.en: Start the game with Leather Trousers, Leather Tunic, Leather Shoes and a Reed Coat.
PerkDescription.ja: 革のズボン、革のチュニック、革靴、葦のコートを持った状態でゲームを開始する。

PerkDescription.zh: 游戏开局自带水袋、皮革包、燧石刀、燧石斧、火镰、木屑和三块硬饼干。
PerkDescription.en: Start the game with Waterskin, Leather Bag, Flint Knife, Flint Axe, Iron Striker, Wood Shavings and three Hardtacks.
PerkDescription.ja: 水袋、革袋、火打石のナイフ、火打石の斧、火打ち金、木くず、堅焼きパン3個を持った状態でゲームを開始する。

PerkDescription.zh: 游戏开局自带简易弓、三支燧石箭、箭袋和一支燧石矛。
PerkDescription.en: Start the game with Simple Bow, three Flint Arrows, Quiver and a Flint Spear.
PerkDescription.ja: 簡素な弓、火打石の矢3本、矢筒、火打石の槍を持った状態でゲームを開始する。

PerkDescription.zh: 游戏开局自带一把燧石锄、两份黑麦粒、两份亚麻种子、两份豌豆和六份骨粉。
PerkDescription.en: Start the game with Flint Hoe, two Rye Grain, two Flax Seeds, two Peas and six Bonemeal.
PerkDescription.ja: 火打石の鍬、ライ麦粒2個、亜麻の種2個、エンドウ豆2個、骨粉6個を持った状態でゲームを開始する。

PerkDescription.zh: 游戏开局自带橡木杖、护身符和装着灵魂菇粉的袋子。
PerkDescription.en: Start the game with Oaken Staff, Amulet and Spirit Powder in a Pouch.
PerkDescription.ja: オークの杖、護符、小袋入りの精霊粉末を持った状態でゲームを開始する。

PerkDescription.zh: 开局自带地图、6 张兽皮纸、一罐墨水和 3 支羽毛笔。
PerkDescription.en: Start the game with Map, 6 Parchments, Jar of Soot Ink and 3 Quills.
PerkDescription.ja: 地図、羊皮紙６枚、煤インク壺、羽ペン３本を持った状態で開始する。

PerkDescription.zh: 开局自带纺锤、梳理器、 3 根铜针、皮革手套和 8 份亚麻籽。
PerkDescription.en: Start the game with Spindle, Hackle, 3 Copper Needles, Leather Gloves and 8 Flax Seeds.
PerkDescription.ja: 糸紡ぎ棒、ハックル、銅針3本、革手袋、亜麻の種８個を持った状態で開始する。

PerkDescription.zh: 开局自带锻造锤、6 个铜块和 3 个锡块。
PerkDescription.en: Start the game with Forge Hammer, 6 Copper Nuggets and 3 Tin Nuggets
PerkDescription.ja: 鍛冶槌、銅塊６個、スズ塊３個を持った状態で開始する。

PerkDescription.zh: 经常下雨。
PerkDescription.en: It rains a lot more.
PerkDescription.ja: 雨がかなり多くなる

PerkDescription.zh: 偶尔下雨。
PerkDescription.en: It rains way less.
PerkDescription.ja: 雨がかなり少なくなる

PerkDescription.zh: 动物种群数量恢复的更慢。
PerkDescription.en: Animal Populations recover slower.
PerkDescription.ja: 動物の個体数回復が遅くなる

PerkDescription.zh: 动物种群数量恢复的更快。
PerkDescription.en: Animal Populations recover faster.
PerkDescription.ja: 動物の個体数回復が早くなる

PerkDescription.zh: 开局拥有一只公鸡、两只鸡和一个巢箱。
PerkDescription.en: Start with a Cock, 2 chicken and a Nesting Box.
PerkDescription.ja: 雄鶏１羽、雌鶏２羽、巣箱１つを所持した状態で開始する。

PerkDescription.zh: 开局拥有一头怀孕母牛、一头公牛和3份干饲料。
PerkDescription.en: Start with pregnant Cow, a Bull and 3 Dry Fodder
PerkDescription.ja: 妊娠した牛１頭、雄牛１頭、乾燥飼葉３つを所持した状態で開始する。

PerkDescription.zh: 在沼泽山丘开始游戏
PerkDescription.en: Start at the Swamp Hill
PerkDescription.ja: Start at the Swamp Hill

PerkDescription.zh: 开局拥有手艺人同伴。他坚实可靠，在建造维护和提供帮助的过程中找到了生命的意义，默默地确保着所爱之人永远不会独自面对困难。
PerkDescription.en:
Makes you start with the Builder partner.  
Steady and dependable, he finds purpose in building, maintaining and providing, quietly ensuring those he loves never face hardship alone.
PerkDescription.ja:
Makes you start with the Builder partner.  
Steady and dependable, he finds purpose in building, maintaining and providing, quietly ensuring those he loves never face hardship alone.

PerkDescription.zh: 开局拥有自定义同伴。
PerkDescription.en: Makes you start with a partner of your own creation.
PerkDescription.ja: Makes you start with a partner of your own creation.

PerkDescription.zh: 开局拥有梦想家同伴。他充满想象力，胸襟宽广且浪漫非常，能在平凡之处发现美的存在，并以此告知身边之人世界仍充满奇迹。
PerkDescription.en:
Makes you start with the Dreamer partner. 
Imaginative, open-hearted and fiercely romantic, he finds beauty where others see only the ordinary, reminding those around him that the world still holds wonder.
PerkDescription.ja:
Makes you start with the Dreamer partner. 
Imaginative, open-hearted and fiercely romantic, he finds beauty where others see only the ordinary, reminding those around him that the world still holds wonder.

PerkDescription.zh: 开局拥有文艺少女同伴。她举止优雅且自信，总能激发人们的钦佩之情并唤醒他们对于追求卓越的渴望，尽管赢得她的芳心绝非易事。
PerkDescription.en:
Makes you start with the Muse partner.  
Graceful and self-assured, she inspires admiration and awakens the desire to become better, though winning her heart is never taken for granted.
PerkDescription.ja:
Makes you start with the Muse partner.  
Graceful and self-assured, she inspires admiration and awakens the desire to become better, though winning her heart is never taken for granted.

PerkDescription.zh: 开局拥有家庭主妇同伴。她耐心且乐于助人，有能力将任何地方充满家的味道，默默地将舒适时光带入日常生活。
PerkDescription.en:
Makes you start with the Nurturer partner. 
Patient and caring, she has the power to turn any place into a home, quietly weaving comfort into everyday life.
PerkDescription.ja:
Makes you start with the Nurturer partner. 
Patient and caring, she has the power to turn any place into a home, quietly weaving comfort into everyday life.

PerkDescription.zh: 开局拥有元气少女同伴。她勇敢且活力满满，总是带着笑容和好奇心迎接每一个挑战，并用无拘无束的永恒热情感染人们去拥抱整个世界。
PerkDescription.en:
Makes you start with the Spirited partner. 
Bold and full of life, she meets every challenge with laughter and curiosity, encouraging others to embrace the world with the same boundless enthusiasm.
PerkDescription.ja:
Makes you start with the Spirited partner. 
Bold and full of life, she meets every challenge with laughter and curiosity, encouraging others to embrace the world with the same boundless enthusiasm.

PerkDescription.zh: 开局拥有不羁者同伴。他遗世独立，随心所欲便能赢得尊重，令人难以看透。
PerkDescription.en:
Makes you start with the Untamed partner. 
Strong, self-reliant and fiercely independent, he commands respect without seeking it, and is difficult to truly know.
PerkDescription.ja:
Makes you start with the Untamed partner. 
Strong, self-reliant and fiercely independent, he commands respect without seeking it, and is difficult to truly know.

PerkDescription.zh: 森林里的狼不再会侵扰你。
PerkDescription.en: The wolves of the forest will leave you in peace.
PerkDescription.ja: 森のオオカミはあなたを襲わなくなる。

PerkDescription.zh: 森林里的狼会渴望你。
PerkDescription.en: The wolves of the forest hunger for you.
PerkDescription.ja: 森のオオカミはあなたを獲物として狙う。

PerkDescription.zh: 从秋季开始。
PerkDescription.en: Start in autumn.
PerkDescription.ja: 秋から開始する。

PerkDescription.zh: 从冬季开始。
PerkDescription.en: Start in winter.
PerkDescription.ja: 冬から開始する。

PerkDescription.zh: 开局解锁的墨水、羽毛笔和兽皮纸的蓝图。
PerkDescription.en: Starts the game with Ink, Quill and Parchment Blueprints unlocked.
PerkDescription.ja: インク、羽ペン、羊皮紙の設計図を解放した状態で開始する。
